selection_rule: Reduced V1 keeps 32 evenly distributed stable logical IDs across the original 64 while maximizing silhouette and cultural-style variety.
canary_rule: Do not launch bulk Headwear until all three canaries pass source-art review, locked-body movement fit, alpha validation and duplicate-silhouette review.
bulk_rule: After canary pass, produce only the remaining approved V1 IDs; never auto-expand to all 64 without explicit user instruction.
